verdict.rationale: Productboard's docs show feedback being linked to features and other hierarchy entities through the UI's automatic insight detection and through dedicated API relationship endpoints. Linked feedback quantifies demand and informs prioritization, and those features can then be pushed into delivery tools such as GitHub issues. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a one-step 'create feature/task from this feedback' action in the UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the workflow.
